scope: One runtime-authored AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE record with a unique existing group-271 INTEGER attachmentDirection value 0 (Horizontal). Its isolated transaction changes only attachmentDirection to 1 (Vertical); all other encoded style fields remain unchanged.

fieldEvidence.fieldRoleSource: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference, MLEADERSTYLE group-code table identifies code 271 as text attachment direction for MText contents
fieldEvidence.valueDomainSource: The Autodesk MLEADERSTYLE group-code table documents the code-271 values 0=Horizontal and 1=Vertical
fieldEvidence.classification: Authoritative Autodesk DXF field-role and value-domain evidence plus authored adapter transaction; not independent producer, native MText layout or consumer semantic acceptance

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The selected record must be reachable from the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, have a source-matched raw body and immutable baseline, and contain exactly one existing group-271 INTEGER matching the parsed attachmentDirection. The target value must be in 0..1. attachmentDirection must be the only changed typed payload field; identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and all other encoded style fields must match the source.
contract.projection: Replace only the existing physical group-271 value in a copy of the captured body. Preserve all other ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated group 271, conflicting raw changes, simultaneous edits, values outside 0..1, unknown subclass grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain outside this transaction.
contract.outputAndReadback: The table-driven regression exercises the group-271 field on ASCII and binary sources, same-format and opposite-format output. It verifies exactly one emitted INTEGER group 271 with value 1, fresh typed readback as attachmentDirection=1, and cross-format readback.
contract.failureAndRetry: Changing captured raw group 271 from 0 to 1 while the typed value requests 1 refuses and preserves a sentinel destination. Typed value 2 is refused atomically. Restoring the original raw body and requesting value 1 permits same-adapter retry. The regression runs for ASCII and binary source profiles.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records keep raw replay. Transactions remain AC1027-only and one field per record. DWG-origin writing is unchanged. This field-level output evidence does not qualify native attachment behavior, other versions or document closure.
